name: Handheld controller-style split housing
brief: An original handheld game-controller style housing (not a copy of any product): a moulded ABS lower shell 150 x 95 x 18 mm and an upper shell 150 x 95 x 14 mm, each with a rounded grip lobe at both ends, meeting on a flat split line and joined by four M3 x 16 socket head screws from below into bosses in the upper shell.
recorded: hand-written graph reply (master-model, 2026-11-20): what the intent step should return for this brief

reply.summary: An original handheld-controller-style housing: two moulded shells screwed together on a flat split line.
